name: xgg-public-release
description: Public release workspace for xgg cloud device control and local gateway automation

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:cloud
scripts.pack:release: rm -rf release-artifacts && pnpm build && pnpm -C packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../release-artifacts && pnpm -C packages/cli pack --pack-destination ../../release-artifacts
